findings.comment: Making the content field optional allows Message.content() to be null. However, Message's Writeable serialization has not been updated: Message(StreamInput in) uses in.readNamedWriteable(Content.class) (line 151) and Message#writeTo uses out.writeNamedWriteable(content). Calling out.writeNamedWriteable with a null content will throw a NullPointerException, and in.readNamedWriteable cannot deserialize a null value when messages are transmitted across cluster nodes.
